narrative: The Sunday sheet is still on the board. New lines sit at the foot, short, and stop. No parliament. No glass redrawn. On the board. One line begun and left without a stop. Blank paper under it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Added a few lines at the foot of Sunday's sheet and did not finish them.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Still at the hedge
